resources.string: The classic. Count down from 501 to exactly zero.
Close 15 to 20 and the bull, score on open numbers.
Hit 1 to 20 in order, then the bull.
Seven rounds, one target number per round.
Become a killer and take your friends\' lives.

Everyone starts at the chosen score. Each dart is subtracted from your score and the first to reach exactly zero wins the leg. With double out, the last dart must be a double (the bull counts as double 25). Going below zero, or to 1 with double out, is a bust: your score goes back to what it was at the start of the turn. With double in, your darts only count after your first double.

Only 15 to 20 and the bull count. Hit a number three times to close it (a double counts as two hits, a treble as three). Once you\'ve closed a number, extra hits score points as long as an opponent hasn\'t closed it yet. The first player to close everything with at least as many points as everyone else wins.

Hit 1, then 2, then 3 and so on up to 20, and finish with the bull (outer or inner). Every segment of the number counts. With \"Doubles and trebles skip\", a double moves you two numbers ahead and a treble three. The first player to hit the bull wins.

In round 1 only the 1 counts, in round 2 only the 2, and so on. Each hit scores its value times the multiplier. A Shanghai (a single, double and treble of the target in one turn) wins the game immediately. Otherwise the highest score after the last round wins.

Every player gets their own number. Hit the double of your number to become a killer. As a killer, every double of an opponent\'s number takes one of their lives, but watch out: hitting your own double costs you a life. Players without lives are out. The last player standing wins.
